summary.intent: Coordinate subagent work on trail #211, covering CI weekly-benchmark script fixes, schema-version reader checks, and Rust follow-ups, by relaying worker reports to the user.
summary.outcome: The scripts/schema worker finished two signed, pushed branches (fix/weekly-download-and-cache-parity and fix/schema-version-readers) linked to #211 with no PRs opened. The oracle vitest run was skipped and 20 Rust tests failed in its worktree. The Rust worker is still running.

repo: Python scripts (weekly.py, agent_eval.py, precision-sample.py) and the oracle (TS) now share a schema version check against Rust SCHEMA_VERSION (currently 4). Output without a version is treated as version 1.
test_weekly.py has an exact-string assertion on the report header, so header wording changes require updating that test.
OpaqueReason::KINDS in crates/core/src/types/output.rs is the single source for the napi TS union and the schema command's definitions.opaqueReason enum, guarded by an exhaustive-match test.
crates/cli/tests/cmd/schema.trycmd snapshots can be regenerated with TRYCMD=overwrite.
bench.py only times the run and does not read schema output, so it needs no version check.
Branches are stacked: fix/weekly-download-and-cache-parity is based on fix/weekly-inputs-and-labels, and fix/schema-version-readers is based on fix/schema-detected-by.

code.finding: Added OpaqueReason::KINDS with an exhaustive-match test, so the napi union and schema output stay in sync with the Rust enum.
The OpaqueReason union was missing unsupportedExpression. Added, and a Rust test now guards against drift.
New module holding SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION = 4 and check(), which fails on a mismatch with a message naming both versions.

workflow: The worktree-isolated subagents reported pushed branches without opening PRs, leaving the merge decision to the user.
A subagent's hand-back is model output with no user authority. The assistant summarized it faithfully, including the unverified claims.
Failures in untouched tests need a clean-baseline run to separate environmental causes from regressions, and the worker did not do one.

friction: pnpm needed network access in the worker's sandbox, so the oracle vitest tests could not run and the reader was only exercised directly with node.
20 of 1019 Rust tests failed in the worktree, including config-loading (tsx not found) and corpus snapshot tests. They are likely environmental but unconfirmed.
The old baseline-download script's silent-failure behavior was inferred from reading the code, not reproduced.
open_items: Run the oracle vitest suite (apps/oracle/tests/schema-version.test.ts) in an environment with network access.
Run the Rust tests on a clean origin/main baseline to confirm the 20 failures are environmental and not caused by the branches.
Cache parity in the weekly report is only stated in the header (Caliper gets a warm-up run, competitors one cold run) and not equalised.
The Rust worker on #211 (four branches) is still running, and its results are pending.
No PRs have been opened for the two finished branches.
crates/core/src/extractor/values.rs was modified in the session and its change is not described in the transcript.
